subject: URGENT - settled money not in my bank account
body: Dashboard is showing my payout from 3 days back as "settled" but I checked my bank account this morning and the money is simply not there. I called my bank and they have no record of receiving anything from you. This is a huge amount for us and I am extremely worried something has gone wrong. Please investigate immediately and tell me where this money actually is, I cannot understand how something can be "settled" and also not exist in my account.
